name: OBD Y-Splitter (Deutsch DT 6P)
description: 1:1 pass-through Y-adapter on the Harley M8 diagnostic port. Bike side DT06-6S -> two DT04-6P branches (Jekill & Hyde stays connected + RoundDash CAN tap). Only CAN-H/CAN-L are tapped for RoundDash.
notes: Pin position of CAN-H/CAN-L on the 6-pin connector is not fixed - verify with a multimeter (~60 Ohm across the CAN pair). No termination resistor in the stub. Power the ESP32-S3 from a separate switched 12 V source, not from the diagnostic port.
